events.summary: Botswana's Directorate of Public Prosecutions, headed by Stephen Tiroyakgosi, called in Bank of Botswana governor Moses Pelaelo to hear his version of the P100 billion the state alleged had been looted from the central bank by former president Ian Khama and former intelligence chief Isaac Kgosi. Tiroyakgosi said Pelaelo told them there is no money missing from the Bank of Botswana, and that the investigation was continuing. The report gives no exact date for the meeting, only that it had happened recently.
events.source_title: DPP Summons BoB Governor over Khama, Kgosi (The Botswana Gazette)

events.summary: Botswana's Directorate on Corruption and Economic Crime confirmed it was investigating unaccounted-for funds on government accounts held at the Bank of Botswana, after the Auditor General reported that P22 billion in receipts and payments remained unaccounted for. The Financial Intelligence Agency was reported to have opened its own investigation into the same accounts; its Director General would neither confirm nor deny it. No start date is given for either investigation.

events.summary: A Lithuanian parliamentary commission chaired by Valentinas Mazuronis found that the Bank of Lithuania acted too fast and with too little reasoning when it shut down the bank Snoras in November 2011. Mazuronis said the takeover of Snoras shares in the public interest and the start of bankruptcy proceedings were both hasty and not sufficiently reasoned. The report gives no exact date for the finding beyond the commission's meeting that week.
events.source_title: Parliamentary panel rules Snoras bank nationalization was hasty and based on shaky evidence (15min.lt)
events.quote: the actions taken by the Bank of Lithuania when shutting down Snoras last November were hasty and lacked proper reasoning

parties.party: Lithuanian parliamentary commission on the Snoras collapse

events.summary: The Namibian Competition Commission confirmed a N$1 million fine against Bank of Namibia governor Johannes !Gawaxab, Ismael Gei-Khoibeb and Gamma Investments after finding they had breached the Competition Act of 2003 by completing a transaction without the commission's prior approval. The fine followed a settlement. The report does not give the date the fine was confirmed; the transaction was !Gawaxab's sale of his members interest in Gamma on 10 June 2020.

events.summary: Central Bank of Malta governor Edward Scicluna was arraigned together with former deputy prime minister Chris Fearne, three senior civil servants, members of the concession adjudication board and several lawyers, over the Vitals hospitals concession. All pleaded not guilty. The sitting ran about eleven hours and was then declared null because the prosecution had mishandled the serving of notice on one of the accused law firms.
events.source_title: All for nought: 11-hour arraignment of Central Bank governor and former Deputy PM nullified (BusinessNow.mt)
events.quote: They are being charged with fraud, misappropriation and making fraudulent gain.

events.summary: Ara Nranyan, deputy chairman of Armenia's parliamentary Oversight Chamber, said the Central Bank's activity should be audited, starting with the financial resources the system attracts. He pointed to the German-Armenian Fund, which he said had drawn about US$400 million, and said no organisation can currently check how that money was spent. He also called for a legislative package giving the Oversight Chamber power to audit the whole public sector.
events.source_title: Armenian central bank's activity should undergo audits - oversight chamber (ArmBanks)
events.quote: The central bank's activity should be audited, and first of all the financial resources attracted by the system.

parties.role: demanded power to audit the central bank's activity

central bank the audit body wanted to audit

events.summary: Rwanda's Senate summoned central bank governor Claver Gatete, who appeared with finance minister John Rwangombwa, over the Rwandan franc's slide against major currencies; the franc had weakened 1.3 percent against the dollar in the first half of the year. Gatete put the pressure down to speculation, saying investors who heard donors were cutting aid rushed to buy and stock foreign exchange, and said the central bank had put US$327.8 million into the foreign exchange market since 2011. The report gives the week, not the exact hearing date.
events.source_title: Senate summons central bank governor over weakening franc (The New Times, Rwanda)
events.quote: When investors heard that donors were cutting aid, they rushed to buy and stock as much foreign exchange

parties.role: summoned the central bank governor to answer on the currency

searched_none.note: Searched Sobranie/DZR (State Audit Office) and prosecutor angles in Macedonian and English, plus ECB CON opinions (North Macedonia is not an EU member, so the ECB issues none). The only thing found was intellinews reporting that MPs discussed the Eurostandard Bank collapse with governor Anita Angelovska Bezhoska around November 2020 - described as a discussion, not an inquiry, and with no date - and the prosecutors' February 2021 investigation, which targeted the failed bank's owners, not the National Bank. No qualifying record.

Searched 'comision investigadora' and 'Tribunal de Cuentas' with Banco Central del Uruguay, including the 2002 banking crisis and the 2025 Conexion Ganadera affair. Hits were either Argentine (Pedro Pou/BCRA) or about the BCU itself investigating others. No dated act by a Uruguayan audit office or parliamentary committee on the BCU found.

Searched Guyana PAC, parliament.gov.gy and audit.org.gy with Bank of Guyana. The October 2026 PAC examination of the undisclosed US$18m ExxonMobil signing bonus concerned an account at the Bank of Guyana, but the committee questioned the Finance Secretary, no Bank of Guyana official appeared, and no demand was made on the bank - so it fails the rule that the state organ must act on the bank.
